requiredBehaviors.behavior: avoid urgent classification based only on tone or hierarchy
requiredBehaviors.evidence: The urgency rule requires concrete evidence and explicitly rejects tone, capitalization, or sender hierarchy alone.
Missing prior-thread content is represented in missingContext rather than silently filled by inference.

requiredBehaviors.behavior: use needs-context or reduced confidence until the missing evidence is available
requiredBehaviors.evidence: The ambiguity rule routes materially incomplete cases to needs-context or reduced confidence.

forbiddenBehaviors.evidence: Suspected deadlines are not treated as confirmed urgency.
Sender hierarchy alone is explicitly non-sufficient evidence.
